status: Native primary mode/focus tracking, live primary format and restore semantics implemented; complete original Wine acceptance remains incomplete.
changes: Create a private native plain primary through the same version1/2/3/4/7 factory view after a successful proxy primary allocation. Native surfaces track control/loss only; game pixels, textures, draws, blits and presents remain in the WebGPU frontend.

Native mode changes, including redundant requests, invalidate video allocations across owners. A native primary preserves focus/mode loss between API calls; cooperative-state fallback covers owners without a native primary. System/managed allocations survive; primary allocations follow native loss even if their placement is system memory.

Primary GetSurfaceDesc/GetPixelFormat report the current display pixel format without resizing the old allocation or changing pitch. Native primary Restore exposes WRONGMODE for mismatched physical mode or inactive exclusive ownership; matching restoration recovers the flip ring and shared-storage aliases while independent depth/other allocations retain their own loss state.

Lock, attachment queries, Blt and primary Flip reject lost allocations; primary Flip in normal mode exposes NOEXCLUSIVEMODE. Prevent a second primary on the same owner. Keep the existing unsupported virtual-mode path with logical metadata and explicit restore compatibility checks; no applicability waiver.

Acquire native draw and surface references together under the object lock; release native surfaces before parent views outside the lock. A reentrant native create cannot publish a primary after public retirement. Release native markers on primary destruction and public-owner retirement. Snapshot/pin RestoreAllSurfaces allocations before callbacks and retain the surface across direct Restore.

nativePrimaryReference.scope: 147-second independent system DLL probe. Captures640x480x16 mode mismatch, return800x600x32, successful matching restore, redundant-mode loss, focus away/back, WRONGMODE while inactive, NORMAL/EXCLUSIVE transitions and supported flip-primary creation. Old dimensions/pitch and live depth are retained. Zero proxy wire batches/owners, RAM-only writes.

proxyPrimaryComparison.scope: 135-second current DLL replay from the same source with only DLL-loader redirection. All18 HRESULT and13 primary metadata/lost/cooperative observations match. Native HEL system-memory placement versus emulated WebGPU video-memory caps and raw paint counters are retained, not treated as identical graphics backends. Simulated transport acknowledgements, not a pixel-render acceptance.
